question: Which café is nearest along the route connecting Lucille Ball Childhood Home, Jamestown, NY to Avalon Hotel & Conference Center, Erie, PA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.286417 42.102703)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-80.083383 42.125528)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.286417 42.102703)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5)
ORDER BY pois.geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-79.286417 42.102703)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Lucille Ball Childhood Home, Jamestown, NY

[3].display_name: Avalon Hotel & Conference Center, Erie, PA
